verdict.rationale: BigCommerce documents a dedicated sandboxes page with a 'Partner Use Sandbox' option for general development use. Its quick-start also directs developers to a free trial store to test API calls and build integrations without affecting live data. The built-in Request Runner adds a way to experiment with the REST APIs. Missing for 10: details on sandbox eligibility and provisioning (it appears tied to partner status), documentation of data isolation, seeding or reset behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox use.
